lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あおい、コーヒー、入れたよ。
lines.style: Gentle offer, almost hesitant. Soft attack on her name. Warm but understated—not seeking praise, just wanting to give. The words come slow, like he's been waiting for the right moment to say them.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Surprised and touched. Quick warm intake of breath at the start. Eyes up to meet his. The gratitude is genuine and simple, not overplayed. A small smile lives in the tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Sincere, not flattering. Soft steady pace. The compliment lands as observation, not performance. Slight emphasis on 'always'—he notices her work, remembers it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Quiet, almost vulnerable. He's said something that matters. No rush to fill the space after. Breath held slightly. The word 'precious' carries the weight of what he doesn't say often.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Really—it's fun every morning with you.
lines.style: Soft conviction. He's answering something deeper than the words. Warm closure, not quite an ending—more like a door left gently open. Exhale at the end, relieved that he said it.
